requirements.text: The system must allow course administrators to configure multiple file uploads on a per-page basis.
The system must allow actors to organize voice clips into a personal portfolio.
The system must allow actors to download voice clips in a flexible format like MP3.
The system must store audio clips in a format optimized for speech.
The system must allow actors to delete recorded voice clips from their portfolio.
The system must allow course administrators to enable or disable web feeds on a per-page basis.
The system must provide a search box on every page after an actor has logged in.
The system must provide a dedicated search page allowing filtering by category and relevance.
The system must allow course administrators to grade assignments and provide feedback.
The system must display grade information only to the appropriate student and the course administrator.
The system must maintain a history of grade changes with timestamps.
The system must provide a wiki for collaborative document creation.
The system must provide a blog engine with tagging, drafting, and commenting capabilities.
The system must provide email and SMS notifications for page updates, configurable by the course administrator.
The system should provide a simple, responsive interface with a single central administrative configuration point.
The system must be backed up on a configurable schedule, including nightly backups with a maximum 6-hour restoration time.
The system should be available 24/7 with a target of 99% uptime.
The system must support at least 1000 concurrent users.
The system must be maintainable without substantial modification to minimize IT staff overhead.
The system must provide relevant, searchable online documentation for users on each page.
The system must provide comprehensive, searchable documentation for system administrators covering maintenance and troubleshooting.
